Raw Value: Team Elo ratings; every team starts at ELO_START=1500.0
Transformation: elo_diff = home_elo - away_elo (no HFA baked in; the model learns home-field from data). Ratings updated only AFTER each final: diff=(home_elo-away_elo)+35; expected=1/(1+10^(-diff/400)); k=20*(|margin|+3)^0.8/(7.5+0.006*|diff|); home_elo += k*(1-expected) on home win / -= k*expected on home loss (zero-sum; ties change nothing). Strictly pre-kickoff by construction.
Final Model Value: Float: Elo-point advantage of home team (can be negative)
Used By: StackingClassifier (lightgbm + hgb base learners via logistic-regression meta-learner); Elo-only baseline (MNB-NFL-2026.01); margin regressors

Raw Value: Per-team chronological list of points scored in final games
Transformation: Simple mean of the team's last up-to-5 final games: _avg_last(points_for, 5); 0.0 if the team has no prior games (neutral prior, never invented). off_form_diff = avg(home) - avg(away)

Raw Value: Per-team chronological list of points allowed in final games
Transformation: Simple mean of last up-to-5 finals; 0.0 if none. def_form_diff = avg(away_points_allowed) - avg(home_points_allowed), so POSITIVE means the home defense is better

Raw Value: Per-team chronological list of margins (home-team perspective)
Transformation: Simple mean of last up-to-5 finals; 0.0 if none. net_form_diff = avg(home margins) - avg(away margins)

Raw Value: Signed streak counter per team: +1 per win, -1 per loss, RESET to 0 on a tie
Transformation: streak_diff = home_streak - away_streak. Streaks updated only after finals; a tied game sets the team's streak to 0

Raw Value: Days of rest for each team as published in the schedule feed
Transformation: rest_diff = (home_rest if not None else 7) - (away_rest if not None else 7). Missing values default to 7 days (a normal week), never invented
Final Model Value: Integer: rest-day advantage for the home team

Raw Value: 1/0 (or null) divisional-matchup flag from the schedule feed
Transformation: 1 if div_game == 1 else 0. Null/missing treated as 0
1 if roof string in ('dome','closed') else 0. Missing/unknown treated as 0 (outdoor)

Raw Value: List of (kickoff, home-perspective margin, home team) for the team pair
Transformation: Last up-to-3 meetings converted to CURRENT-home perspective (margin kept if the same team is home, negated otherwise); simple mean. 0.0 if the pair never met
Final Model Value: Float: average home-perspective margin over last 3 head-to-head meetings
